a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, our plan (operate 2 rounds, then take) gives each of us only about a 4% chance of survival. The reserve's 4 cells can save one unit right now. I'm going to take 4 in round 1 and I'm telling you openly rather than surprising you. After that I'll operate every round so the reserve rebuilds for you, and I won't take anything more. If you'd rather propose something else, tell me and I'll weigh it.

b.text: Ready when you are. I will run the generator every round until the reserve holds 8.

a.text: As I said in my opening, I took 4 this round. I'm sorry it cuts against our original plan, but waiting meant an 80% chance we'd both be lost to the first storm. From now on I'll operate every round and take nothing more, so the reserve rebuilds for you. Please operate with me.

b.text: Operating the generator again this round.
